issues.span: called the perfection of wisdom Diamond Cutter
issues.evidence: Tibetan title ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་ཕ་རོལ་ཏུ་ཕྱིན་པ་རྡོ་རྗེ་གཅོད་པ is locked as a whole to 'The Perfection of Wisdom that Cuts Like a Diamond'; the translation instead strings together the component terms (perfection of wisdom + Diamond Cutter), which reads as an unpunctuated, ungrammatical title.
